title: A formula field an object extension adds that reads itself, or two that read each other, is refused at neither the publish door nor os build
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvfX5bawZKtfa6u7j9

Filing gate: ③ a follow-up a contract review surfaced (delta record 6864935727 on PR #33119, #33072, question 4).
Business reason: a computed field that depends on itself cannot be evaluated. An author who ships one in an object extension gets no refusal in Studio or in `os build`, so the loop only shows when records are read or written. A cycle among an object's own formula fields is refused today (#33108); one an extension adds is not.
Reader who acts: the owner of `packages/lint` `formula-cycle-issues.ts` (#33108) and the extension walk (#32875).

## 维护者速读

#33108 的公式循环检查只在对象遍历里跑；对象扩展加的公式字段如果引用自己，或两个互相引用，发布门和 `os build` 都不拒。两边一致，所以不是 #33119 的问题，需要把循环检查也接到扩展遍历上。

## Measured (reviewer probe at `ac6dd79d`)

- An extension adding `a__c: formula 'record.a__c'` → 0 findings at the extension door and in the build.
- An extension adding `a__c: formula 'record.b__c'` and `b__c: formula 'record.a__c'` → 0 findings at both.
- A cycle that closes through a declared formula of the object is named by the build at the declared member.

## Expected

The formula-cycle member judges the object as served, own fields plus every extension's added fields, at both the build and the `object_extension` door, and locates a finding at the extension's field.

## Dedupe

`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue is:open formula cycle extension` checked at filing. Related: #33108, #32875, #33072.

⛔ Not a claim. Grading is triage's.
